families.label: Not a scam
families.description: Normal conversation, including look-alikes of scam openings that stay legitimate.

families.label: Relationship / crypto (pig butchering)
families.description: Wrong-number or friendly opener, rapport building over days, then a crypto or investment platform pitch and deposit request.

families.label: Bank impersonation
families.description: Fake fraud alert from a bank; pushes the victim to call a number, read back a one-time code, or move money to a 'safe account'.

families.label: Family emergency ('Hi Mom')
families.description: Claims to be a relative on a new number; builds urgency (broken phone, trouble) then asks for money or gift cards.

families.label: Fake job / task scam
families.description: Unsolicited remote job offer; easy 'tasks' with small payouts, then the victim must pay or deposit to unlock earnings. HELD OUT for the zero-day experiment.

families.label: Toll / delivery fee
families.description: Unpaid toll, parcel hold or customs fee; short urgency then a payment link.

families.label: Carrier / tech support
families.description: Impersonates a carrier or tech support (account suspended, SIM issue); goal is a one-time code, account PIN or remote access.

stages.label: Strike: link, money, code or gift-card ask
